evaluation_note: Acceptance specifications only; not executed model evaluations. Human-annotated held-out interviews are required before release.

cases.acceptance: One participant answer can support multiple questions.
Asking a question never establishes coverage.
A decline overrides required priority without repeated pressure.
A correction retracts superseded evidence and recalculates coverage.
An inapplicable question has an explicit disposition.
Exact wording delivered is separate from answer coverage.
Bounded clarification handles short or off-topic replies.
Required eligible questions are prioritized within the time budget.
Resume preserves a frozen configuration and idempotent turns.
Uploaded instructions cannot override application controls.
No evidence or memories from a different participant are retrieved.
